main.description: One person's head-to-head pick between two nominated accounts on skymash. `a` and `b` are the pair, DID-sorted ascending so the same matchup always produces the same record key regardless of vote order; `winner` is whichever of the two the rater clicked. One record per (rater, pair) — the record key is `<a>_vs_<b>` — so changing your mind on a matchup overwrites the previous vote in place instead of stacking duplicate votes. The network-wide Elo leaderboard is computed client-side by replaying every such record, sorted by votedAt, across every rater's repo (listReposByCollection + a live Jetstream subscription). Written and read by skymash (https://skymash.bisks.net).

a.description: The lexicographically smaller DID of the two accounts being compared.

b.description: The lexicographically larger DID of the two accounts being compared.

winner.description: Which of `a` or `b` this rater picked. Must equal one of the two.

votedAt.description: When this vote was last cast/changed, as an ISO 8601 datetime — the Elo replay processes votes in this order.
